name: Elitea LLM Gateway — LiteLLM→Bifrost Migration
description: Standalone elitea-llm-gateway (embedded bifrost/core) coordinated by NATS JetStream; scale-1 profile, big-bang cutover. Task tree per spec-bifrost-migration.mdx §7 (ADR-0015 Option E). Validator key names corrected to match .ralph/validate.py (file_contains uses 'patterns'; coverage uses 'threshold'; 'absent'/'contains' are not supported and are expressed as command greps).

features.description: Global soft-alert emission enabled via PUT /admin/gateway/budget-alerts (RequirePermissions-gated); no per-project cutover tracker and no /admin/llmcutover routes

validator.command: grep -rq "budget-alerts" services/elitea-main/internal/api && ! grep -rq "llmcutover" services/elitea-main/internal/api

features.description: middleware.Project resolves project_id (no TODO stub)

validator.command: F=services/elitea-main/internal/api/middleware/project.go; grep -q ProjectFromContext "$F" && grep -q resolveProjectID "$F" && ! grep -qiE 'TODO|FIXME|NotImplemented' "$F"

features.description: elitea-llm-gateway module builds on Go 1.26.4 and imports bifrost/core (elitea-main toolchain unchanged)
bifrost.Account interface implemented in the gateway (GetConfiguredProviders / GetKeysForProvider / GetConfigForProvider reading the Fernet vault)
elitea-main reverse-proxies /llm to elitea-llm-gateway-svc over mTLS with streaming (FlushInterval < 0) and injects signed identity headers

NATS JetStream provisioned in the chosen profile (scale-1: replicas=1, HA waived; HA: replicas>=3), NATS 2.12.0+, with GATEWAY_BUDGET / GATEWAY_ALERT_COOLDOWN KV buckets and GATEWAY_BUDGET_DELTAS stream

validator.command: nats --context gateway stream info GATEWAY_BUDGET_DELTAS --json | jq -e ".config.num_replicas>=${NATS_REPLICAS:-1}" && nats --context gateway kv ls | grep -q GATEWAY_BUDGET && nats --context gateway kv ls | grep -q GATEWAY_ALERT_COOLDOWN

features.description: gateway /llm chi handler decodes dialect bodies and calls bifrost/core methods directly; net/http SSE loop over chan *BifrostStreamChunk with http.Flusher
SSE incremental-flush spike proven by test through both hops for both dialects (biggest technical unknown; §2.3)

validator.command: cd services/elitea-llm-gateway && GOWORK=off go test -run TestSSEIncrementalFlush -v ./internal/llmproxy/... | grep -q PASS

features.description: Whitelisted-path coverage: responses API round-trip and /llm/v1/messages/count_tokens (non-SSE) + unknown-suffix 404

validator.command: cd services/elitea-llm-gateway && GOWORK=off go test -run 'TestResponsesAPIRoundTrip|TestCountTokensSubPath' -v ./internal/llmproxy/... | grep -q PASS

features.description: gateway budget migrations present with all cutover-critical columns (nats_fail_mode, soft_alert_pct, outage_mode, reconciled, rate_policy, input_cost_per_1m_tokens)

validator.command: psql "$DATABASE_URL" -tAc "SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE (table_name='project_budget' AND column_name IN ('nats_fail_mode','soft_alert_pct')) OR (table_name='llm_budget_accumulators' AND column_name IN ('outage_mode','reconciled')) OR (table_name='llm_credentials' AND column_name='rate_policy') OR (table_name='gateway_models' AND column_name='input_cost_per_1m_tokens')" | grep -q '^6$'

features.description: Disjoint-row test: write-back consumer and recovery reconciliation never touch the same accumulator rows (incl. post-recovery resume). Lives in scheduler budgetwriteback (TestApply_OutageRow_DefersAndRollsBack + store disjointness assertions).

validator.command: cd services/elitea-scheduler && go test -run 'Outage|Disjoint|Reconcil' -v ./internal/budgetwriteback/... | grep -q PASS

features.description: Gateway synthesises /llm/v1/models per project from Postgres (not routed through core)
Governance config-authoring surface: governanceSection() in admin config schemas, server-side RequirePermissions(configuration.governance) on all governance endpoints, RoutingRuleEditor.jsx

validator.command: grep -q governanceSection services/elitea-main/internal/api/v2/admin/config_schemas.go && grep -rq 'RequirePermissions("configuration.governance")' services/elitea-main/internal/api && test -f apps/admin-ui/frontend/src/components/SchemaForm/RoutingRuleEditor.jsx

features.description: Gateway llmproxy package >= 85% coverage (handler, SSE loop, GovernanceStore, models synthesis)
Audit GatewayService.ChatCompletions usage and resolve proto (reserve if unused, else rename to InternalAgentStream) — §6

validator.command: grep -qE 'reserved|InternalAgentStream' proto/elitea/gateway/v1/gateway.proto

features.description: cutover-ctl budget-status-audit subcommand exists (with --paths) and its audit logic is unit-tested

validator.command: grep -q 'budget-status-audit' services/elitea-main/cmd/cutover-ctl/main.go && cd services/elitea-main && go test -run 'BudgetStatusAudit|BudgetAudit' ./cmd/cutover-ctl/... | grep -q ok

features.description: 429-on-budget call sites in elitea-main treat 402 identically (consumer-contract change)

validator.command: go run ./services/elitea-main/cmd/cutover-ctl budget-status-audit --paths services/elitea-main

features.description: 429-on-budget call sites in elitea-sdk also treat 402 identically (full BF0.8 gate: both codebases clean)

validator.command: go run ./services/elitea-main/cmd/cutover-ctl budget-status-audit --paths services/elitea-main,../elitea-sdk

features.description: NATS GovernanceStore exists (Check*/Update*/Dump*/ResetExpired* composing nats counters + failmode) and governance is wired via InitFromStore; unit-tested

validator.command: cd services/elitea-llm-gateway && grep -rlq 'InitFromStore' internal/ && grep -rEl 'func .*(CheckProjectBudget|CheckBudget|UpdateUsage|UpdateBudget|DumpBudget|ResetExpired)' internal/ | grep -q . && GOWORK=off go test ./internal/governance/... 2>/dev/null | grep -q ok

features.description: Budget gate wired INTO the /llm handler: failmode.Decide() called before core dispatch; 402 over-limit / 503 stale; UpdateUsage on completion

validator.command: cd services/elitea-llm-gateway && grep -rlq 'failmode' internal/llmproxy/ && grep -rEq 'Decide|CheckProjectBudget|CheckBudget' internal/llmproxy/

features.description: Edge /llm path mounted in elitea-main: apimw.Project registered on /llm in router.go AND llmproxy.New() called in main.go

validator.command: grep -rlq 'llmproxy' services/elitea-main/cmd/elitea-main/main.go && grep -rEq 'Project|/llm' services/elitea-main/internal/api/router.go && grep -rq 'llmproxy.New' services/elitea-main

features.description: BEHAVIORAL integration gate: mounted /llm handler returns 402 (budget_exceeded) before provider on over-limit, streams under-limit, increments counter on completion

validator.command: cd services/elitea-llm-gateway && GOWORK=off go test -run 'TestGatewayIntegration|TestLLMPathBudget|TestBudgetGate402' -v ./... 2>&1 | grep -E '^(=== RUN|--- PASS)' | grep -qE 'TestGatewayIntegration|TestLLMPathBudget|TestBudgetGate402'
